proposals.reason: The assembled problem gives the hypotenuse and one leg, sets |BC|=a and requires A to be on the perpendicular through C with |AB| equal to the given hypotenuse. The existence condition in p0139#10 is c>a. Thus the locus of A about center B has radius c=|AB|, not the point C. Replacing only capital C by lowercase c yields (B,c), consistent with the given data and the subsequent existence condition. This is an author proposal, not registered or approved errata.
